# Angular Component Designer Skill

> **Category:** Tech Skills > Frontend > Angular

## Overview

Designs and builds reusable, well-structured Angular components with proper lifecycle management, input/output binding, and change detection optimization

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [angular-component-designer-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
angular-component-designer-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@angular-component-designer` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Design component architecture with smart/dumb component patterns
- Implement OnPush change detection for performance
- Create dynamic components with ViewContainerRef
- Build content projection with ng-content and ng-template

## Technology Standards Applied

- **Angular Style Guide**: Official component design patterns and naming conventions
- **Component Architecture**: Smart/dumb component separation and data flow patterns
- **A11y Standards**: WCAG 2.1 AA compliance for component accessibility
